title: Ernesta Workforce Control Map
scope: 24 starter platform, business, control and recovery workflows. Business-specific definitions require customer configuration and acceptance tests.

components.role: Business interface, agent roles and customer-owned state
Scheduling, queues, attempts and tracing; self-hosted instance
Browser workflows, extraction, validation and artifacts; self-hosted instance
Structured native desktop control through OS accessibility trees; local tool, no embedded model
Durable action identity, request hashes and append-only events
Scope, permissions, budgets and approval checks
Explicit outcome checks outside model self-report
Customer-selected hosted provider; prompts leave this server

workflows.name: Install and configure
workflows.input: Approved host, deployment version, provider and secret references
workflows.success: Configuration accepted and private login reachable
workflows.failure: Missing Docker, model capability or storage permission
workflows.recovery: Correct the failing preflight; rerun only that check.

workflows.name: Connect a business account
workflows.input: Approved service, scopes, credential reference
workflows.success: Read-only identity check matches intended business
workflows.failure: Expired login or wrong account
workflows.recovery: Stop; reconnect the correct account without broadening scopes.

workflows.name: Answer an owner message
workflows.input: Authenticated message and conversation ID
workflows.success: Answer persisted with source references where applicable
workflows.failure: Provider unavailable or response cut short
workflows.recovery: Keep original context; retry a read-only generation within budget.

workflows.name: Delegate to a specialist
workflows.input: Goal, allowed tools, deadline and expected evidence
workflows.success: Specialist result verified and linked to parent run
workflows.failure: Specialist stuck or missing evidence
workflows.recovery: Stop its work; preserve records; reassign only unfinished safe steps.

workflows.name: Run scheduled work
workflows.input: Workflow version, schedule, timezone, overlap policy
workflows.success: One recorded run per due occurrence
workflows.failure: Worker downtime or overlapping occurrence
workflows.recovery: Reconcile occurrence IDs; never run a second scheduler for the same job.

workflows.name: Research an approved business
workflows.input: Company, approved source hosts and extraction schema
workflows.success: Source-linked facts with timestamps, not invented claims
workflows.failure: Site layout changed, blocked page or conflicting facts
workflows.recovery: Capture evidence; stop or use an approved alternative source, not an unrestricted fallback.

workflows.name: Triage an incoming message
workflows.input: Message ID, source account, permitted categories
workflows.success: One classification and proposed next action per message
workflows.failure: Duplicate webhook or ambiguous intent
workflows.recovery: Return existing decision; escalate ambiguity instead of sending a reply.

workflows.name: Prepare a reply or follow-up
workflows.input: Conversation, verified facts, editorial rules
workflows.success: Reviewed draft; nothing sent
workflows.failure: Unsupported claim or policy violation
workflows.recovery: Return to drafting with failed checks; never silently publish.

workflows.name: Send an approved message
workflows.input: Exact recipient, channel, content hash and approval
workflows.success: Provider message ID plus read-back or delivery evidence
workflows.failure: Timeout after send; outcome may be unknown
workflows.recovery: Look up provider message/action key. Do not resend until non-execution is established.

workflows.name: Update a CRM record
workflows.input: Record ID, expected version, field diff
workflows.success: Read-back matches approved field changes
workflows.failure: Version conflict or partial update
workflows.recovery: Re-read and re-approve changed diff; compensate only with a separate authorized action.

workflows.name: Extract and review a document
workflows.input: Authorized file reference and extraction schema
workflows.success: Schema-valid fields with source locations and uncertainty flags
workflows.failure: Unsupported format or low-confidence field
workflows.recovery: Keep original file; request review of exact field, not a guessed value.

workflows.name: Download portal invoices
workflows.input: Approved portal, credential reference, date range
workflows.success: Downloaded files hashed; invoice IDs and counts reconciled
workflows.failure: MFA, duplicate files or interrupted download
workflows.recovery: Ask owner for MFA; retry missing downloads by invoice ID; deduplicate by hash.

workflows.name: Submit an approved business form
workflows.input: Named form, field values, attachments and signed approval
workflows.success: Receipt or destination record matches the approved submission
workflows.failure: Navigation changed or submission timed out
workflows.recovery: Reconcile confirmation/record first; never repeat a possibly completed submission.

workflows.name: Prepare a quotation
workflows.input: Approved price list, customer requirements and terms
workflows.success: Draft totals verified; dispatch separately approved
workflows.failure: Missing price or unsupported term
workflows.recovery: Block that line item; obtain authoritative data rather than inventing a quote.

workflows.name: Resolve a support request
workflows.input: Ticket ID, policy and allowed resolution types
workflows.success: Documented resolution; consequential changes separately approved
workflows.failure: Conflicting policy, refund or account-change request
workflows.recovery: Escalate to owner; no financial or account action without scoped approval.

workflows.name: Produce a daily operations report
workflows.input: Time window and authorized run/event records
workflows.success: Reconciled report separates verified, failed and unknown outcomes
workflows.failure: Missing source records or stale snapshot
workflows.recovery: Mark the gap explicitly; do not infer success from silence.

workflows.name: Repair a changed website step
workflows.input: Failed step, before/after evidence and workflow version
workflows.success: New version passes sandbox regression before promotion
workflows.failure: Repair changes business intent or permissions
workflows.recovery: Reject the patch; compare against approved contract and preserve old version.

workflows.name: Handle an inference outage
workflows.input: Provider error class, attempt count and budget
workflows.success: Explicit retry, pause or authorized provider change
workflows.failure: Rate limit, malformed stream or provider outage
workflows.recovery: Bounded read-only retry; no hidden provider fallback or tool execution from partial output.

workflows.name: Approve or reject a consequential step
workflows.input: Workflow version, exact action hash and expiry
workflows.success: Decision applies only to the unchanged action
workflows.failure: Stale approval or changed recipient/amount
workflows.recovery: Invalidate approval; request a new decision on the changed payload.

workflows.name: Reconcile an uncertain external action
workflows.input: Action ID, request hash and remote evidence
workflows.success: Confirmed executed, confirmed not executed, or still unknown
workflows.failure: Lost response after possible execution
workflows.recovery: Keep OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until independent evidence resolves it; time alone is not proof.

workflows.name: Cancel an active run
workflows.input: Root run ID and child run IDs
workflows.success: Stop confirmed for parent and children; completed effects remain recorded
workflows.failure: Remote cancellation acknowledgement without stop
workflows.recovery: Remain CANCELLING or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until observed; no false rollback claim.

workflows.name: Back up and restore a customer
workflows.input: Data directory, keys and owned volumes
workflows.success: Restore drill verifies hashes, credentials and task records
workflows.failure: Missing vault key or inconsistent snapshot
workflows.recovery: Do not overwrite live data; repair backup or restore last verified snapshot.

workflows.name: Upgrade or roll back a deployment
workflows.input: Pinned version, backup and acceptance gates
workflows.success: New build passes tests on customer host before traffic switch
workflows.failure: Build fails, new schema or degraded behavior
workflows.recovery: Keep old release; rollback code only with compatible data or verified restore.

workflows.name: Export data and revoke access
workflows.input: Export scope, retention policy and revocation list
workflows.success: Customer retains data and runtime; third-party support access revoked
workflows.failure: Unverified export or shared credentials
workflows.recovery: Stop destructive steps; verify export and rotate only identified access.
